message_ja: v0.3.56 は SoapyRemote（別マシンに挿した RTL-SDR / HackRF を LAN 経由で使用）まわりの改善です。リモートホスト接続時のハング修正、「Add Remote Host」でのシリアル番号表示、Windows での DLL 読み込み不具合の修正を含みます。
message_en: Version 0.3.56 improves SoapyRemote support (use an RTL-SDR / HackRF plugged into another machine over the LAN): it fixes a hang when connecting to a remote host, shows the device serial in Add Remote Host, and fixes a Windows DLL loading issue.
_comment: Bump latest_version on every release. Raise minimum_supported_version and set critical=true only when older versions genuinely misbehave and every user must update; otherwise keep critical=false. See docs/app-update.md.
